lines.en: I swim slowly, tilted on my side.

lines.zh: 我的身体扁得像一扇门。
lines.en: My body is flat as a door.
I row forward with two short fins.
I take a wide turn in the sea.
I drift a stretch with the current.

lines.zh: 我浮到水面晒了晒太阳。
lines.en: I rise to the surface to sun myself.
I hardly have a tail at all.
I ride the cold current toward the shallows.
I move along the light on the surface.
I swim with my mouth open.
I bank into a wide turn.
Cold water makes me even slower.
I slide sideways across the sea's face.

lines.zh: 我的背鳍高出水面一截。
lines.en: My dorsal fin rises above the surface.
I sink and rise, drifting inch by inch.
I right myself a little.
Seabirds circle above me.
I go slowly off into the distance.
I float on my side at the surface.
The sun has warmed my skin.
I hold my mouth open and do not move.
My fins rock up and down.
I have pale patches on my hide.
Seawater slides off me.
I stay still until the wind drops.
I roll over lazily.
My shadow far below is very faint.

lines.zh: 我被水流推得偏了一点。
lines.en: The current nudges me off line.
I listen to the sound beneath the boat.
I release a string of bubbles.

lines.zh: 我几乎不动，让海带我走。
lines.en: I barely move and let the sea carry me.
There is an old scar on my hide.
You stand in the boat; I can see you.
I am large, but very slow.
Your line has not caught me.
I turn and show you my back.
There is little in the sea that can hurt me.
You mean to put me in a bucket?
I am sunning myself. Do not hurry.
I have plenty of meat, though it is not fine eating.
Jump in and the water will be cold.
I will sink slowly away.
I rolled onto my side.

lines.zh: 冷海里翻着身，晒着太阳。
lines.en: In the cold sea I roll over and bask.
I sank to hide for a while.
I roll sideways and show my white belly.
A thread of red spreads in the water.

lines.zh: 我慢慢把身子正过来，海水很冷。
lines.en: I slowly right myself; the seawater is cold.
I have gone almost still.
My mouth is open and my gills work fast.
I have come up again.
I can still swim slowly.
Something is floating on the surface.
I close in slowly, on my side.
That much bait will not fill my mouth.
I open my mouth and try.
I lie on my side to sun.
You threw it too close.
One flick of the fin pushes the bait aside.
I drift along with it a while.
That will not even fill my mouth.
I turn slowly and move off.
You struck my back. It is hard.
The shove tipped me askew.
My body slaps the water loudly.
We pass each other, both slow.
Your boat touched me.

lines.zh: 我慢慢滑到船的另一边。
lines.en: I slide slowly to the boat's other side.
The splash wets your sleeve.

lines.zh: 你的船帮压到我的背鳍。
lines.en: Your hull presses down on my dorsal fin.
I roll over and keep floating.
Move back and I can right myself.
Two sunfish lie pressed to the surface.
Your shadow touches mine.

lines.zh: 海流把我们的影子叠上。
lines.en: The current lays our shadows one over the other.
I keep to your pace.
This stretch of sea is room enough.
We head slowly for warmer water.
I touch you with a fin.
If the birds come, we dive together.

lines.zh: 我们在水上晃了一整天。
lines.en: We bobbed on the water all day.
Same sea tomorrow.
I open my mouth and draw it in.
Not edible. I spat it out.
I push it to one side with a fin.
It is stuck at the edge of my mouth.
I dive and rise again.
This reflects light brightly.
One gulp and it is in.

lines.zh: 水面上的东西都会被海带去。
lines.en: The sea takes everything on the surface.
I nose it slowly to the boat.
That mouthful does not interest me.
I look up at the boat.
I only want to float.
You are very near the water's edge.

lines.zh: 我翻正身子对着你的船。
lines.en: I right myself and face your boat.
I turn my flat body broadside.

lines.zh: 你跳下来的话，我就在这。
lines.en: If you jump in, I am right here.
This patch of surface is mine for sunning.
Throw something and I will catch it.
I do not hurry. I drift with the water.
At a splash I know.
On my side, I follow the boat.

lines.zh: 你走到哪边，我就偏哪边。
lines.en: Whichever side you take, I lean that way.
I sink slowly beneath the boat.
Look down and you will not see me.
The shadow on the surface moves.
I wait for the net to come up.
There is a hole in your boat.
My dorsal fin draws a line.
I edge slowly toward the boat.
I stay alongside your boat.
I strike the boat's hull.
The boat rocks hard.
I roll up and my fin slices past.
You are drenched in seawater.
I sink and rise again, slowly.

lines.zh: 我这扇门一样的身子侧过来撞。
lines.en: This door-flat body of mine swings sideways.
I rolled over in the water.
You gripped the gunwale.
I drifted a few feet away.
The sea has gone flat again.
I rise slowly from the depths.
There is one more pale shape on the sea.
I rise from dark water into the light.

lines.zh: 阳光照在我扁扁的身上。
lines.en: Sunlight lies on my flat body.
I float on my side by the boat.
The water is cold, and I do not mind.

lines.zh: 海洋的翻车鱼，游得很懒。
lines.en: Ocean sunfish drift lazily.
The seabirds scatter when they see me.

lines.zh: 我在两股水流之间停下。
lines.en: I settle between two currents.
I roll over, belly to the sky.

lines.zh: 火在水面上，我不敢靠近。
lines.en: There is fire on the water. I keep away.

lines.zh: 我从半空落水，砸得很响。
lines.en: I fall into the water with a heavy slap.

lines.zh: 我明明在海里，却觉得喘不上。
lines.en: I am in the sea, and yet I cannot breathe.

lines.zh: 水被炸开，我被掀起来了。
lines.en: The water bursts and I am thrown up.

lines.zh: 尖锐的东西刺进了皮里。
lines.en: Something sharp went into my hide.

lines.zh: 一股寒气贴着我的皮爬。
lines.en: A cold crawls along my skin.
There is nothing left on the surface.

lines.zh: 雷打在海面，我浑身一颤。
lines.en: Lightning strikes the sea and my body shudders.
I begin to sink, and there is no bottom.
